remarks: Discover the charm of this beautifully renovated 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo in Linden House Condominium. This stunning home features a spacious living room, a formal dining room, and a modern kitchen equipped with stainless steel appliances and granite countertops. Each bedroom offers ample closet space, with the primary suite boasting a walk-in closet. Enjoy the comfort and convenience of this prime location, with onsite storage and an assigned parking spot included. The HOA covers heat and hot water, and the complex is pet-friendly with no rental restrictions. This condo truly offers everything you need for a comfortable and convenient lifestyle.
